rules.title: Wrong Font Family
rules.description: Text is not using IBM Plex Sans Arabic, the mandatory DGA typeface.
rules.detection_visual: Inspect rendered font — if the letterforms don't match IBM Plex Sans Arabic (check Arabic glyph shapes and Latin 'g' style), the wrong font is loaded.
rules.detection_code: Check computed font-family on body and all text elements. Must resolve to 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic'.
rules.recommendation: Load IBM Plex Sans Arabic via Google Fonts or self-hosted. Set as the primary font-family on body. Ensure Arabic and Latin text both use this family.

rules.title: Font Size Not From DGA Scale
rules.description: Text uses a font size that doesn't exist in the DGA typographic scale (12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30, 36, 48, 60, 72px).
rules.detection_visual: Text appears slightly off from standard sizes — e.g., 15px instead of 14px or 16px.
rules.detection_code: Extract computed font-size of all text elements. Compare against allowed set: [12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30, 36, 48, 60, 72].
rules.recommendation: Map all font sizes to the nearest DGA scale value. Use CSS custom properties (--text-md: 16px) from the DGA token set.

rules.title: Incorrect Line Height for Font Size
rules.description: Text uses a line-height that doesn't match the DGA-specified pairing for its font size.
rules.detection_visual: Text feels too tight or too loose compared to the DGA reference templates.
rules.recommendation: Set line-height using the DGA scale pairing. E.g., text-md (16px) must use line-height 24px (1.5).

rules.title: Invalid Font Weight
rules.description: Font weight used is not one of the four DGA-approved weights (400, 500, 600, 700).
rules.detection_visual: Text appears thinner (300/light) or different from the four standard DGA weights.
rules.detection_code: Check computed font-weight. Must be one of: 400 (Regular), 500 (Medium), 600 (Semibold), 700 (Bold).
rules.recommendation: Remove font-weight: 300, 100, 800, 900 usage. Map to nearest DGA weight.

rules.title: Display Text Missing Negative Tracking
rules.description: Display-size text (24px+) does not have the required -2% letter-spacing.
rules.detection_visual: Large headings look slightly too spread out compared to DGA reference.
rules.detection_code: For text ≥ 24px (display-xs and above), check if letter-spacing is approximately -0.02em.
rules.recommendation: Add letter-spacing: -0.02em to all display-level headings (30px and above). Display-xs (24px) and below should have normal tracking.

rules.title: Color Not From DGA Palette
rules.description: An element uses a color that doesn't exist in any DGA palette (neutral, primary SA, gold, lavender, or semantic).
rules.detection_visual: A color appears that doesn't match the green/gray/gold tones of the DGA system.
rules.detection_code: Extract all used colors (text, background, border). Compare against the full DGA palette hex values.
rules.expected: All colors from DGA palettes only
rules.recommendation: Replace with the nearest DGA palette color. Use CSS custom properties mapped to DGA tokens (e.g., --color-sa-600: #1B8354).

rules.title: Wrong Semantic Color Usage
rules.description: Semantic colors used for wrong purpose — e.g., error color (#D92D20) used for non-error content, or success color used for warnings.
rules.detection_visual: Red used for non-error elements. Green used for warnings. Blue used for success messages.
rules.detection_code: Map semantic color usage to context: Error palette → error states only, Warning → caution only, Success → confirmation only, Info → informational only.
rules.recommendation: Ensure semantic colors are used exclusively for their intended purpose. Error 600 (#D92D20) for errors, Warning 600 (#DC6803) for warnings, Success 600 (#079455) for success, Info 600 (#1570EF) for info.

rules.title: Text Color Not From DGA Text Palette
rules.description: Text uses a color not defined in the DGA text color system for its context (light/dark background).
rules.detection_visual: Text color doesn't match the gray-950/700/600 for light backgrounds or white/70%/60% for dark backgrounds.
rules.detection_code: On light bg: primary text must be #0D121C, secondary #384250, tertiary #4D5761. On dark bg: primary #FFFFFF, secondary rgba(255,255,255,0.7), tertiary rgba(255,255,255,0.6).
rules.recommendation: Map all text colors to DGA text palette tokens. Use --text-primary, --text-secondary, --text-tertiary variables.

rules.title: Gradient Not From DGA Definitions
rules.description: A gradient is used that doesn't match any of the 6 DGA-defined gradient combinations.
rules.detection_visual: A green gradient that doesn't match the specific SA-600→SA-500 or other defined pairs.
rules.detection_code: Extract gradient stops and angles. Compare against the 6 defined DGA gradients.
rules.recommendation: Use only DGA-defined gradients. The primary gradient is SA-600 (#1B8354) → SA-500 (#25935F) at 90°.

rules.title: Spacing Off 4px Grid
rules.description: Margin, padding, or gap values are not multiples of the 4px base unit.
rules.detection_visual: Uneven visual rhythm. Elements don't align to a consistent grid.
rules.detection_code: Extract margin, padding, gap values. Check if each is divisible by 4. Exception: 2px (spacing-xxs) and 6px (spacing-sm) are allowed.
rules.expected: All spacing values from DGA spacing scale (multiples of 4px, plus 2px and 6px)
rules.recommendation: Round spacing values to nearest DGA token. Use spacing-md (8px) instead of 7px or 9px.

rules.title: Container Padding Wrong
rules.description: Container/page padding doesn't match DGA spec: 16px on mobile, 32px on desktop.
rules.detection_visual: Content appears too close to screen edge (mobile) or has inconsistent outer padding.
rules.detection_code: Measure main container horizontal padding. Mobile (≤768px): should be 16px. Desktop (>768px): should be 32px.
rules.recommendation: Set container padding using DGA tokens: container-padding-mobile (16px) and container-padding-desktop (32px).

rules.title: Container Max-Width Exceeded
rules.description: Content area exceeds the DGA maximum container width of 1280px.
rules.detection_visual: Content stretches beyond comfortable reading width on large screens.
rules.detection_code: Measure max-width of main content container. Must not exceed 1280px.
rules.recommendation: Set max-width: 1280px (80rem) on the main content container. Center with margin: 0 auto.

rules.title: Paragraph Width Exceeds Maximum
rules.description: Paragraph text width exceeds the DGA maximum of 720px, harming readability.
rules.detection_visual: Long lines of body text that are hard to track from end to beginning of next line.
rules.detection_code: Measure max-width of paragraph elements. Should not exceed 720px.
rules.recommendation: Set max-width: 720px (45rem) on paragraph containers. This is the DGA paragraph-max-width token.

rules.title: Border Radius Not From DGA Scale
rules.description: An element uses a border-radius value not in the DGA radius scale (0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 9999px).
rules.detection_visual: Rounded corners that don't match the consistent rounding across DGA reference pages.
rules.detection_code: Extract computed border-radius. Must be one of: 0, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 9999 (full/pill).
rules.recommendation: Map border-radius to nearest DGA token. Use radius-md (8px) for standard components, radius-lg (16px) for cards, radius-full for pills/avatars.

rules.title: Shadow Not From DGA Elevation Scale
rules.description: Box-shadow values don't match any of the 7 DGA shadow definitions.
rules.detection_visual: Shadow appears different from the subtle DGA elevation style — too dark, too wide, or wrong angle.
rules.detection_code: Parse box-shadow CSS. Compare against DGA shadow tokens (xs through 3xl).
rules.expected: One of: shadow-xs, shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, shadow-2xl, shadow-3xl
rules.recommendation: Replace custom shadows with DGA shadow tokens. Shadow color must always be #101828 at specified opacity. Avoid colored shadows.

rules.title: Excessive Elevation Usage
rules.description: Too many shadow levels used on a single page, or heavy shadows (2xl, 3xl) used on small elements.
rules.detection_visual: Page feels overly layered with excessive shadow depth. Small elements cast unrealistically large shadows.
rules.detection_code: Count distinct shadow levels per page. Flag if >3 levels or if shadow-2xl/3xl used on elements <200px.
rules.expected: 2-3 shadow levels per page, appropriate to element size
rules.recommendation: DGA recommends subtle elevation. Use shadow-xs or shadow-sm for most components. Reserve shadow-lg+ for modals and overlays.

rules.title: Wrong Grid Column Count
rules.description: Page layout doesn't use the DGA grid structure: 12 columns desktop, 6 tablet, 4 mobile.
rules.detection_visual: Content doesn't align to a visible column structure. Elements appear off-grid.
rules.detection_code: Inspect grid or flexbox layout. Desktop should show 12-column alignment. Tablet (≤768px): 6 columns. Mobile (≤375px): 4 columns.
rules.expected: Desktop: 12 col, Tablet: 6 col, Mobile: 4 col
rules.recommendation: Implement the DGA grid system using CSS Grid with 12 columns and 32px gutters (16px on mobile).

rules.title: Wrong Grid Gutter Size
rules.description: Grid gutters don't match DGA spec: 32px on desktop/tablet, 16px on mobile.
rules.detection_visual: Columns appear too close together or too far apart compared to DGA reference.
rules.detection_code: Measure gap/gutter between grid columns. Desktop/Tablet: 32px. Mobile: 16px.
rules.recommendation: Set grid column-gap to 32px for desktop and tablet, 16px for mobile breakpoint.

rules.title: Wrong Breakpoint Values
rules.description: Responsive breakpoints don't align with DGA definitions: desktop 1280px, tablet 768px, mobile 375px.
rules.detection_visual: Layout breaks or shifts at unexpected viewport widths.
rules.detection_code: Check CSS media queries for breakpoint values. Should use 1280px, 768px, and 375px.
rules.recommendation: Use DGA breakpoints for all media queries. Set viewport-specific styles at these exact widths.

rules.title: Missing RTL Support
rules.description: Arabic content page doesn't have dir='rtl' attribute or text alignment is incorrect.
rules.detection_visual: Arabic text aligned to the left. Navigation on the left instead of right. Layout not mirrored.
rules.detection_code: Check html or body for dir='rtl'. Verify text-align on Arabic content is 'right' or 'start'.
rules.expected: dir='rtl' on html element for Arabic pages
rules.recommendation: Set dir='rtl' on the <html> element. Use CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start) instead of margin-left.

rules.title: Navigation Not Mirrored for RTL
rules.description: Navigation menu and header elements are not mirrored for Arabic RTL layout as shown in DGA templates.
rules.detection_visual: Logo should be on the right, nav items flowing right-to-left. Status bar (weather, date, time, location) should be in correct RTL order.
rules.detection_code: Check nav element flex-direction or float direction under dir='rtl'. Logo should be flex-end or right-aligned.
rules.expected: Full RTL mirroring as per DGA home page template
rules.recommendation: Mirror entire navigation: logo right, menu items right-to-left, utility bar (weather/time/location) left-to-right reading order preserved.

rules.title: Form Labels Not RTL Aligned
rules.description: Form labels and inputs are not right-aligned for Arabic as shown in DGA Contact Us template.
rules.detection_visual: Form labels appear on the left, inputs align left — not matching the DGA contact form template.
rules.detection_code: Check form label text-align and input alignment under RTL context.
rules.expected: Labels right-aligned, inputs right-aligned, placeholders right-aligned
rules.recommendation: Ensure all form elements respect dir='rtl'. Labels should be right-aligned above or beside their inputs.

rules.title: Missing Header Status Bar
rules.description: DGA home page template requires a top status bar showing weather, date, time, and location (city).
rules.detection_visual: Page lacks the top utility bar seen in the DGA home page template above the main navigation.
rules.detection_code: Check for a top bar element containing weather, date, time, and location data.
rules.expected: Top bar with: weather icon + condition, date, time, location (city name)
rules.recommendation: Add a header status bar matching the DGA template: [weather icon] [condition] [date] [time] [location pin] [city].

rules.title: Missing Hero Section Pattern
rules.description: DGA home page template uses a hero section with green gradient background, heading text on the right, CTA button, and image/illustration on the left.
rules.detection_visual: Home page lacks the characteristic green hero banner with right-aligned RTL heading and CTA.
rules.detection_code: Check for hero/banner section with DGA green gradient background (SA-600 to SA-800 range).
rules.expected: Green gradient hero with RTL heading + CTA + left-side visual
rules.recommendation: Implement the hero section per DGA template: green gradient background, right-aligned heading and description, primary CTA button, illustration/image on the left side.

rules.title: Contact Form Missing Required Pattern
rules.description: Contact form doesn't follow DGA contact page template: breadcrumbs, 2-column name fields, email + phone row, subject + category, textarea, file upload, submit button.
rules.detection_visual: Contact form layout doesn't match the DGA reference with its specific field arrangement.
rules.detection_code: Check form structure for: breadcrumb nav, first/last name side-by-side, email/phone side-by-side, subject/category, textarea, file upload, submit CTA.
rules.expected: DGA contact form field layout and order
rules.recommendation: Structure the contact form per DGA template: breadcrumbs at top, 2-column layout for name and contact fields, full-width textarea, file upload component, primary green submit button.

rules.title: Text Contrast Below DGA Minimum
rules.description: Text doesn't meet the DGA-specified WCAG contrast requirements: 4.5:1 for small text (<24px), 3:1 for large text (≥24px).
rules.detection_visual: Text appears hard to read against its background. Light text on medium backgrounds.
rules.detection_code: Calculate contrast ratio using DGA-specified thresholds: small text (<24px) needs 4.5:1, large text (≥24px) needs 3:1.
rules.recommendation: Use DGA text color tokens which are pre-tested for contrast: primary text (#0D121C) on light backgrounds gives 15.4:1 ratio.

rules.title: UI Component Contrast Below 3:1
rules.description: Interactive UI components (buttons, inputs, icons) don't meet the DGA-required 3:1 contrast ratio against adjacent colors.
rules.detection_visual: Input borders, icon buttons, or interactive elements are hard to distinguish from background.
rules.detection_code: Calculate contrast of UI component boundaries against adjacent background. Must be ≥3:1.
rules.recommendation: Use DGA palette colors that meet 3:1 minimum. Gray-400 (#9DA4AE) on white gives 3.2:1. For stronger contrast, use Gray-500+ (#6C737F).
